genres: Casual; Massively Multiplayer; RPG; Free To Play
short_description: VtuberStory is a multiplayer casual game where you step into a VTuber’s unique world as an adventurer. Collect resources through mining, fishing, and hunting, then trade them for outfits to customize your look. Explore, build, and connect with VTubers and fellow fans in a vibrant virtual village!
